title: DashboardJoinParams
description: Client to server: the phx_join payload for topic live:dashboard. Window and threshold of the traffic movers panel (§13.3); the user's saved dashboard preferences. To change them, leave and join again. refreshSeconds sets how often summary, movers and tops are pushed (team trial round 1).

refreshSeconds.description: Push period in seconds: summary every refreshSeconds, movers and tops every max(5, refreshSeconds).
